title: S06a retirement — superseded by S06b (2026-11-27)
body:
# S06a retirement — superseded by S06b

## Context

S06a planned an HMAC-signed channel between the conveyor and `nonagenticai_mcp_server`. On
2026-11-08 SPEC D19 made the conveyor's own `/mcp` the agent interface; S06b supersedes S06a and
its gate forbids an `mcp_server` component in the path. S06a's own plan says nothing there is
built or to be built.

## Decision

S06a is retired by recorded supersession. It is not rebuilt. The capability is delivered by
S06b's agent interface; the HMAC channel and its shared secret do not exist.

## Consequences

No `nonagenticai_mcp_server` component is introduced. The conveyor's `/mcp` is the one agent
interface; S06b's gate proves a real agent task with `decided_by_kind='agent'`. S06a stays in the
register as an archived historical project, with this decision as its disposition.

## Evidence

`docs/plans/slices/S06a-mcp-server-channel.md` lines 14-17 (the supersession);
`docs/plans/slices/S06b-agent-direct-interface.md` lines 18-19 and 181-182 (the successor and the
no-rebuild trap); S06b's green receipt `docs/evidence/rework/S06b.json`.
